issues.problem: Final readout pack D10 is due week 18, four weeks after the last go-live (D7, week 14), under the plan's five-week minimum for cost data to show the effect.
issues.fix: Lengthen the running period to 6 to 7 weeks, or start go-lives earlier, so the readout pack has 5 full weeks of cost data after the last go-live.

issues.problem: Criterion 1 requires cost per part down 'by a measurable amount', but no meeting sets that amount; G6 approves results 'against the baseline' with no yardstick.
issues.fix: Add to G3's decision the cost-per-part reduction the client accepts as success, taken from the sized pack D4, and make G6 judge results against that figure.

issues.problem: Baseline is sized once per plant (driver sites, one week), yet W5 reads cost per part on each of three lines; no line-level baseline exists to compare against.
issues.fix: Add a per-line baseline work piece driven by production_lines (3) to the Diagnostic and re-size its weeks, so each line's cost per part has a starting point.

issues.problem: W6 Plant team capability answers no sub-question, and its training work is sized in no phase; G6 also decides a 'handover', which the brief never mentions.
issues.fix: Add a sub-question on plant ownership of the improvements and size its work in Implementation, or drop W6, D11, D12 and the handover wording at G6.
